		has_global_flag = zin_eindil_stage_9_done
		check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage = 10 }
		check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage = 11 }
	}
	OR = {
		has_global_flag = zin_afrit_dead
		NOT = { zin_eindil_afrit_foes_exist = yes }
		zin_afrit_reduced = yes
	}
}
zin_eindil_next_stage_ready = {
	OR = {

	zin_eindil_has_host = yes
